hookups.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/naples/site-type/rv-camping-sites/ (every RV site type is 'FULL HOOKUPS', 50/30 or 50/30/20 amps) + https://koa.com/campgrounds/naples/amenities/ ('50 Max Amp'), read 2026-10-21 in a browser

values.note: Back-in KOA Patio and C-row sites and pull-thru A/B-row sites; the A-row patio pull-thrus are about 70 x 30 ft, the B-row ones about 19 ft wide.

sites.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/naples/amenities/ ("72' Max Length") + https://koa.com/campgrounds/naples/site-type/rv-camping-sites/ (site types 'PULL THRU, 50/30/20 AMPS, FULL HOOKUPS ...'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 24-hour laundry; free basic Wi-Fi campground-wide (no streaming); pool and hot tub open year-round; propane fills; shallow-water boat ramp ($8), kayak rentals.

facilities.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/naples/amenities/ ('24/7 Laundry', 'Dump Station', 'Wi-Fi', 'Shallow Water Boat Ramp') + https://koa.com/campgrounds/naples/ ('a Kampstore and a 24-hour laundry room') + https://koa.com/campgrounds/naples/general-information/ ('Free basic Wi-Fi is offered throughout the campground'; 'Boat Ramp Fee - $8.00'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book on koa.com or 1-239-774-5455. Late arrivals without a reservation self-register at the yellow building across from the store. RV sites: cancel by 4 p.m. seven days before arrival for a refund less $20. Rate covers up to 6 people. The reserving adult must be 21+.

booking.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/naples/general-information/ (Night Registration: 'If you do not have a reservation, please fill out one of the white envelopes provided and chose from one of the available sites for the night'; Cancellation Policy; No Extra People Fees; Minimum Age Requirement) + https://koa.com/campgrounds/naples/ ('Reserve: 1-239-774-5455'), read 2026-10-21

note: KOA Holiday at 1700 Barefoot Williams Road, Naples, backed by Rookery Bay mangroves. --Claude
